primary_result: All 625 independent validation scenes jointly passed the frozen reconstruction, local optical-thickness heterogeneity, and permuted-depth separation rules, giving a two-sided Wilson 95 percent lower bound of 0.993891, above the preregistered 0.90 gate. The official scene-airlight-beta filename interpretation was independently fixed on 375 definition scenes: its median reconstruction RMSE was 0.002275 versus 0.494129 under the reversed token interpretation.
gate_reasons: The parent OTS source-qualification tuple and exact 964-scene exclusion asset matched, leaving the authorized 8,006-scene disjoint OTS pool.
The official OTS identities and complete factorial layout matched: 8,970 clear scenes, 8,970 depth fields, 313,950 haze variants, and 35 variants per scene.
All 1,000 selected clear scenes completed with no exclusions: 375 definition scenes and 625 disjoint validation scenes.
Every validation scene passed reconstruction; the scene median true-depth RMSE was 0.002270 and the maximum scene median was 0.019536, below the frozen 0.025 rule.
Every validation scene passed local heterogeneity; the minimum heavy-beta tau q95-q05 range was 0.123570, above the frozen 0.050 rule.
Every validation scene passed the spatial negative control; the minimum permuted-minus-true median RMSE was 0.006526, above the frozen 0.005 margin.
The validation joint qualification rate was 625/625 with Wilson 95 percent interval [0.993891, 1.000000].
competing_explanation: Global airlight and beta tokens alone could have produced low apparent error without useful local depth information. The circularly permuted independent-scene depth control was materially worse on every validation scene, so that explanation does not account for the observed reconstruction under the frozen measurement. This discrimination is synthetic and associational; it is not causal validation of real-haze restoration demand.
limitations: This is L1 development-screening evidence for RESIDE OTS synthetic outdoor optical thickness only.
OTS depth and beta are official generation fields, not validated labels for real spatially varying scattering or restoration demand.
The result authorizes only a separately frozen official ConvIR-B outdoor baseline-behavior measurement design; it does not authorize model selection, module design, or training.
No model, checkpoint, training, inference, SOTS outcome, Haze4K outcome, NH-HAZE, confirmation, canary, or locked-test evidence was accessed.
